final_sql:
SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`School Type` = 'K-12 Schools (Public)'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;
